title: Problem
问题
html:
Current conversational LLMs usually assume that users already know what they want and only need help expressing or executing it. This assumption fails in open-ended tasks such as creative writing or design, where users often form preferences only after seeing concrete alternatives. Repeated clarification questions cannot reveal a preference that has not yet been formed.

DiscoverLLM therefore treats intent discovery as a distinct problem. It trains assistants to present useful possibilities, observe how the user’s preference becomes more concrete, and balance exploration with efficient task completion.

现有对话式 LLM 通常假设用户已经明确知道自己想要什么，只需要模型帮助表达或执行。但在创意写作、技术写作和设计等开放任务中，用户往往需要先看到具体草稿或不同方案，才能逐渐形成偏好；当偏好尚未形成时，反复追问也无法直接获得答案。

DiscoverLLM 因此把“意图发现”视为独立问题，训练助手主动呈现有价值的可能性，观察用户偏好如何逐步具体化，并在探索新方向与高效完成任务之间取得平衡。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DiscoverLLM makes the progressive concretization of latent user intent the main supervision target. A hierarchical user simulator reveals only currently discovered requirements, while an intent-discovery reward favors assistant responses that expose useful refinements and later satisfy them.

The authors release DiscoverLLM-multiturn-preferences, containing 9,318 English candidate responses across creative writing, technical writing, and SVG drawing. Each record includes dialogue context, one candidate completion, a reward score, latent-intent history, and provenance, supporting reward modeling and preference optimization.

DiscoverLLM 将“用户潜在意图逐步具体化”设为核心监督目标。层级化用户模拟器只表达当前已经发现的需求，而意图发现奖励会偏好能够提出有效细化方向、帮助用户形成新偏好，并在后续满足这些偏好的助手回应。

作者开放 DiscoverLLM-multiturn-preferences，包含创意写作、技术写作和 SVG 绘制三个领域共 9,318 条英文候选回应。每条记录包括对话上下文、候选 completion、奖励分数、潜在意图历史和来源信息，可用于奖励模型、DPO 或其他偏好优化训练。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build intent trees. Requirements are extracted from source artifacts and repeatedly abstracted into hierarchical parent–child intents.
  2. Initialize the simulated user. Only several abstract root intents are initially visible; undiscovered child intents cannot be directly stated.
  3. Generate candidates. The assistant samples several responses at each turn, including drafts, questions, and alternatives.
  4. Update intent states. A judge determines whether each response reveals or satisfies latent refinements and changes nodes from undiscovered to emerging or discovered.
  5. Construct training signals. Newly discovered intents provide reward, excessive length is penalized, and candidate responses become scored records or preference pairs for SFT, DPO, and GRPO.

1. 构建意图树。 从创意写作、技术写作和 SVG artifact 中提取具体要求，再逐层抽象为父子结构的潜在意图。
  2. 初始化模拟用户。 对话开始时只公开少量抽象根意图，尚未发现的子意图不能被用户直接表达。
  3. 生成候选回应。 助手在每轮采样多个草稿、问题或替代方案。
  4. 更新意图状态。 judge 判断回应是否揭示或满足潜在细化方向，并将节点从未发现更新为形成中或已发现。
  5. 形成训练信号。 新发现意图产生正奖励，过长回应受到惩罚，候选最终形成 SFT 对话、DPO 偏好对或 GRPO 标量奖励。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main controlled experiment compares DiscoverLLM with the unmodified base model, prompted intent-discovery baselines, and CollabLLM under the same 8B model families and five-turn simulated conversations. The best Qwen3-8B variant improves the normalized Discovery score by 13.7% in creative writing and 14.3% in technical writing, while using 31.9% fewer tokens.

A separate study with 75 participants reports higher satisfaction and interaction efficiency. Together, the simulated comparison and human study support the claim that the method improves open-ended intent discovery, although they do not establish effectiveness in high-stakes or long-term settings.

核心受控实验在相同 8B 基础模型家族和五轮模拟对话下，将 DiscoverLLM 与原始模型、加入意图发现提示词的模型以及 CollabLLM 比较。最佳 Qwen3-8B 变体在创意写作和技术写作上的归一化 Discovery 分数分别相对提高 13.7% 和 14.3%，同时生成 token 均减少 31.9%。

论文还开展了 75 人用户研究，参与者报告更高满意度和交互效率。模拟评测与人工研究的趋势一致，支持方法对开放式意图发现有效；但这些证据不能证明它同样适用于高风险决策、长期交互或偏好频繁反转的用户。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Clarification-oriented methods such as CollabLLM assume that the user already has a fixed hidden requirement and train the assistant to uncover it through questions. They are less effective when the user cannot answer because the preference itself has not yet formed.

DiscoverLLM changes the modeled object from a fixed hidden intent to a hierarchy that becomes concrete after the user observes candidate outcomes. It also replaces generic task-success rewards with newly discovered intent refinements and an efficiency penalty. User simulation, DPO, and GRPO are not new individually; the novelty is using them to supervise intent formation.

CollabLLM 等澄清式方法通常假设用户已经拥有一个固定但尚未表达的目标，助手只需通过追问将其提取出来。当用户自己尚未形成更具体的偏好时，这种假设便不成立，继续追问也无法获得有效信息。

DiscoverLLM 将建模对象从固定隐藏意图改为会在用户观察候选结果后逐渐具体化的层级状态，并把监督信号改为新发现的意图细化数量与交互效率。用户模拟、DPO 和 GRPO 本身并不新，真正的新意是利用这些机制训练模型帮助用户形成意图。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
First, the simulator assumes that latent preferences already exist and become progressively more concrete. Real users may reverse earlier choices, abandon an option, or develop a new goal that was not present in the intent tree; the system may then mistake model steering for successful discovery.

Second, the intent trees, transition judge, reward, and main simulated evaluation share the same ontology. A model may learn artifacts of this formalization rather than general collaboration. The released scores are also model-generated rather than human preference labels. Reuse therefore requires independent human validation and tests of non-monotonic preference changes.

第一，模拟器假设潜在偏好已经存在，只是会逐步具体化。但真实用户可能推翻早期选择、放弃某个方向，或形成意图树中原本不存在的新目标；此时系统可能把模型对用户的引导错误地判断为成功发现意图。

第二，意图树、状态转移 judge、训练奖励和主要模拟评测共享同一套 ontology，模型可能只学习这种形式化结构的特征，而不是真正提升开放式协作能力。开放数据中的分数也由模型产生，并非人工偏好标签。复用前应加入独立用户评测，并测试偏好反转和非单调变化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Researchers building collaborative writing or design assistants can group candidate responses by conversation turn and convert higher- and lower-scored outputs into DPO pairs or reward-model records. Success should be evaluated through intent discovery, final satisfaction, interaction quality, and token cost.

The intent-tree and simulator pipeline can also be adapted to another open-ended domain by extracting artifact requirements, constructing latent refinements, and generating multi-turn supervision. It is unsuitable when goals are fixed and externally verifiable, or when unintended steering could create legal, medical, or safety risks without direct human review.

面向协作写作、设计或创意生成的研究者，可以按对话轮次对候选回应分组，将高分与低分回应组成 DPO 偏好对，或直接训练奖励模型。复用效果应同时通过意图发现数量、最终需求满足、交互质量和 token 成本评估，而不能只观察最终任务分数。

研究者也可以将“提取 artifact 要求—建立潜在意图树—模拟部分意图—生成多轮反馈”的流程迁移到其他开放领域。当任务目标固定且可由外部 verifier 直接判断，或模型引导可能造成法律、医疗和安全风险时，不应在缺少真实用户监督的条件下直接采用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: DiscoverLLM trains assistants to help users form intentions, not merely reveal fixed hidden requirements.
  2. Method handle: Intent-tree construction, partial-state user simulation, candidate generation, transition judging, and discovery reward are the decisive steps.
  3. Artifact handle: The released dataset contains 9,318 English candidate-level records with context, completion, score, intent history, and provenance.
  4. Evidence anchor: The best Qwen variant improves Discovery by 13.7%–14.3% with 31.9% fewer tokens; 75 users also report better satisfaction and efficiency.
  5. Reuse decision: It is suitable for multi-turn preference learning in open-ended creation, but independent human checks are required to detect simulator bias and user steering.

1. 一句话定位：DiscoverLLM 训练助手帮助用户逐步形成意图，而不是只提取已经确定但尚未表达的需求。
  2. 方法抓手：关键步骤是构建意图树、模拟部分意图状态、生成候选回应、判断状态转移和计算发现奖励。
  3. 数据抓手：开放数据包含 9,318 条英文候选级记录，字段覆盖对话上下文、completion、分数、意图历史和来源。
  4. 证据锚点：最佳 Qwen 变体的 Discovery 提高 13.7%–14.3%，token 减少 31.9%；75 人研究也显示满意度和效率改善。
  5. 复用决定：适合开放式创作中的多轮偏好学习，但必须用独立人工评测检查模拟器偏差和模型引导风险。
